content.text: Keep a simple register of suppliers: each has a name, a contact email, a country and an active flag. Users add and edit suppliers and see them all in one list sorted by name; inactive suppliers stay visible but greyed out.
IN: one Supplier entity and one screen to list, add and edit suppliers.
OUT: links from other records to suppliers, supplier contacts beyond one email, import/export, approval workflow.
None — keeping the bean's rows through its screen.
R1: WHILE a supplier is inactive, the system SHALL show its row in the supplier list greyed out and SHALL keep it in the list.
R1: an inactive supplier remains in the list, shown greyed out.
A plain list of all suppliers, sorted by name ascending by default; inactive rows are greyed out. A supplier is added or edited in a side panel showing its default form.

cells.text: one row per Supplier (name, contactEmail, country, active), sorted by name; inactive rows greyed out
the selected or new row's default form

content.text: None — no existing entity or spec is reused.
Considered, none apply: authorization beyond the platform default, performance, volume, availability, audit beyond the platform trail, privacy, locale, cost.
A1 (verifies R1) (manual): WHEN the list shows an inactive and an active supplier, the inactive one appears greyed out and the active one does not; both are present.
None — new entity, nothing to migrate.
Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block, and write nothing else under Artifacts.

persistence.entity: Supplier (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).
observer.sheet: Supplier (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

ui.defaultForm: Supplier (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.
validation.rule: Supplier.contactEmail (persistence): format(email address) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test

ui.screen: Suppliers (ui): for Supplier: A designed screen over a root bean, reached from the navigation: its regions, what each shows and the actions it offers, authored in the User interface section as a '### screen:' block with a mock attachment.
ui.navigation: Suppliers (ui): at 'Procurement › Suppliers': The navigation entry reaching a designed screen, at the group and label the screen block's menu line names.
